==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am chasing after a villain in a digital world. I leap over a moving train on a motorcycle. This leads me to a seemingly abandoned factory.
I am accompanied by someone I have never met before. Together we have to solve codes to move through the factory. Most of the codes we seem to be able to guess.
My mysterious friend rushes into a trap and is surrounded by vampires and werewolves in a garage. I am unable to save him. I am safe where I am, but I don't know where to go next.
